locale.description: BCP 47 code for number and date formatting; do not translate

extDescription.message: Blocks ads and trackers so pages load faster and use less data. Checks any site's speed, security and privacy.

statusSiteOff.message: Protection is off on this site

blockedTitle.message:
Blocked on this page
Ads: $ADS$
Trackers: $TRACKERS$

trackersFound.message: This site tracks you. Trackers blocked: $COUNT$

extendedText.message: Extended mode: hosting, IPv6, HSTS, statistics and hiding ad slots and cookie pop-ups on all sites. Data never leaves your browser.

extendedOffTitle.message: The extension will stop seeing server IPs and headers, keeping statistics and hiding ad slots and cookie pop-ups on all sites; access to all sites will be revoked. You can turn it back on at any time

cookiesTitle.message: Blocks cookie consent banner services. In extended mode it also hides the banners themselves on any site

siteTitle.message: Uncheck if the site doesn't work properly: ads and trackers on it will no longer be blocked. The page will reload

guess.message: Detected by indirect signs — may be inaccurate

weightEstimated.message: Exact size is known for $KNOWN$ of $TOTAL$ files, the rest are estimated: third-party sites hide the size

compressionOff.message: The page is sent uncompressed — it loads slower

companyFound.message:
Found on the site:
$LIST$
Whether they are blocked is shown in extended mode

serverReloadTitle.message: The server is detected while the page loads

serverProxy.message: The site runs behind $NAME$ (CDN or DDoS protection) — the real server is hidden

serverCountry.message: Country is determined by the provider

techNoneTitle.message: No signs of known engines or libraries found

ipv4.message: Connected over IPv4. This doesn't tell whether the site supports IPv6: it also depends on your network

hstsOn.message: HSTS: the browser always opens the site over HTTPS only

hstsOff.message: No HSTS: the first visit to the site may happen without encryption

mixedTitle.message: The HTTPS page loads files without encryption: $COUNT$

statsTitle.message: Since $DATE$. Size is estimated from the average size of ad files

reportText.message: Site report — as an image or text

reportTitle.message: Site score and details as an image or text — for colleagues, a contractor or a chat

askStats.message: Requests blocked: $COUNT$, saved ≈ $SIZE$. If ABlock helps you, please support its development

askTime.message: You have been using ABlock for a month. If it helps you, please support its development

companiesNoneTitle.message: No companies from the ABlock directory on this page. The site's own counters may still be there — they are counted by the “Trackers” badge

clearTitle.message: Delete site data and reload: cookies, cache and storage. Badges and score will show the site as a new visitor sees it. You will be logged out of this site

shareAsText.message: Sent as text: an image can't be passed without uploading it to a server — copy it and paste it into the message

shareLinkOnly.message: Only the extension link is passed — copy the report image and paste it into the post

auditTtfbHint.message: How long it took to get the first byte of the page from the server. Good — under 0.8 s

auditFcpHint.message: When the first content appeared on screen. Good — under 1.8 s

auditLcpHint.message: When the largest block — an image or text — was painted. Google's main speed metric. Good — under 2.5 s

auditClsHint.message: How much the content jumps while loading. Good — under 0.1

auditInpHint.message: The longest delay in responding to a click or input. Good — under 200 ms

auditBlockingHint.message: Files the browser waits for before it starts drawing the page. Styles are fine, but scripts are better loaded with async or defer

auditStatusHint.message: HTTP status of the page: 200 — OK, 4xx and 5xx — error

auditNoindexHint.message: The page is hidden from search engines with a noindex tag or a robots.txt rule. This is normal for login pages and user accounts

auditTitleHint.message: Link text in search results and the tab name. Best — 10–70 characters

auditDescriptionHint.message: Text under the link in search results. Best — 50–170 characters

auditH1Hint.message: The main heading of the page. Usually there is one

auditCanonicalHint.message: Tells search engines the main address of the page if it has copies

auditOgHint.message: Title and image shown by Telegram, Slack and other services when a link is shared

auditViewportHint.message: Without meta viewport, phones show the page as a scaled-down desktop version

auditDoctypeHint.message: Without it, the browser switches to compatibility mode for old sites, and the layout may differ

auditNoSizeHint.message: Without width and height, the browser doesn't know how much space to reserve for an image, and the layout jumps when it loads

auditLargeHint.message: The image is sent noticeably larger than it is displayed — extra weight

auditModernHint.message: These formats are 25–50% smaller than JPEG and PNG

auditLangHint.message: Needed by screen readers, translators and search engines

auditAltHint.message: A description of the image for blind users and in case it fails to load

auditLabelsHint.message: A screen reader won't be able to tell what to enter in the field

auditNamesHint.message: For example, an icon button without aria-label: a blind user will hear just “button”

auditMainHint.message: Lets users jump straight to the content, skipping the menu

auditZoomHint.message: Prevents visually impaired users from zooming the page on a phone

auditCspHint.message: Restricts where the page can load scripts from — protection against XSS. If it contains 'unsafe-inline' without a nonce or hash, it barely protects

auditNosniffHint.message: Stops the browser from guessing file types — protection against script spoofing

auditFrameHint.message: X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors prevent embedding the site in someone else's page to trick users into clicks

auditReferrerHint.message: How much of the page address is passed to other sites on navigation. Without the header, the browser uses a safe default

auditCacheHint.message: Where the page came from: HIT — from the server or CDN cache, MISS — built anew. Pages themselves are rarely cached; usually images, scripts and styles are

auditRobotsHint.message: Rules for search engines and other robots. Without the file, robots crawl everything, and search engines don't learn where the sitemap is

auditSitemapHint.message: A list of pages for search engines. Specified in robots.txt with a Sitemap: line

auditAiHint.message: Whether AI bots may collect the site's texts for neural networks — based on robots.txt rules that name the bot. The extension knows 16 such bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.); bots with other names are not counted. “Closed to all” — the site is closed to all robots via User-agent: *, with no separate rules for AI

auditLlmsHint.message: A new format: a short Markdown description of the site for AI assistants and agents. Optional for now

auditPermissionsHint.message: Denies the page and embedded frames access to the camera, geolocation and other browser features

auditCoopHint.message: Isolates the site's window from other windows it opens — protection against window.opener attacks

auditVersionsHint.message: The server reveals software versions — a hint to attackers about which known vulnerabilities to try. To hide: server_tokens off in nginx and Angie, expose_php = Off in PHP

auditSessionHint.message: Login cookies seem to be readable from JavaScript: with XSS they can be stolen. The HttpOnly flag prevents this. Detected by cookie name

auditSecurityTxtHint.message: Contacts for vulnerability reports in /.well-known/security.txt. Helps a researcher report a problem to you instead of selling it

serverUnknownTitle.message: This provider's networks are not in the ABlock database: it covers major hosting providers, clouds and CDNs

protocolH3Later.message: The server supports HTTP/3. This page came over $PROTOCOL$ — this happens on the first visit: the browser learns about HTTP/3 from the server's response and switches to it for subsequent requests

notePlaceholder.message: Note for this site, visible only to you

incognitoTitle.message: Opens the browser extension settings — turn on Incognito access for ABlock there
